mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT r.id FROM biz_refund r WHERE NOT r.deleted AND r.status IN ('pending','processing','succeeded') AND next_attempt_at <= clock_timestamp() AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < clock_timestamp()) AND (status != 'succeeded' OR first_attempt_at > clock_timestamp()-interval '31 days') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM biz_payment p WHERE p.id=r.payment_id AND NOT p.deleted) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), claimed AS ( UPDATE biz_refund r SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '2 minutes', first_attempt_at=COALESCE(r.first_attempt_at,clock_timestamp()), version=r.version+1,update_time=clock_timestamp() FROM candidate c WHERE r.id=c.id RETURNING r.id,r.payment_id,r.amount,r.currency,r.provider_refund_id,r.first_attempt_at,r.version ) SELECT r.id,r.payment_id,r.amount,r.currency,p.provider_payment_intent_id AS provider_intent_id, p.status AS payment_status,p.amount AS paid_amount,p.currency AS paid_currency, r.provider_refund_id,r.first_attempt_at,clock_timestamp() AS now,r.version FROM claimed r JOIN biz_payment p ON p.id=r.payment_id AND NOT p.deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_refund SET provider_refund_id=#{providerId},status=#{status},last_result=#{result}, lease_until=NULL,update_time=clock_timestamp(), next_attempt_at=clock_timestamp()+CASE WHEN #{status}='succeeded' THEN interval '1 hour' ELSE interval '30 seconds' END WHERE id=#{work.id} AND version=#{work.version} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM biz_payment p WHERE p.id=payment_id AND NOT p.deleted)
mapper.select: WITH claimed AS ( UPDATE biz_refund SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '2 minutes', version=version+1,update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE payment_id=#{paymentId} AND NOT deleted AND status IN ('review','failed') AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < clock_timestamp()) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM biz_payment p WHERE p.id=biz_refund.payment_id AND NOT p.deleted) RETURNING id,payment_id,amount,currency,provider_refund_id,first_attempt_at,version ) SELECT r.id,r.payment_id,r.amount,r.currency,p.provider_payment_intent_id AS provider_intent_id, p.status AS payment_status,p.amount AS paid_amount,p.currency AS paid_currency, r.provider_refund_id,r.first_attempt_at,clock_timestamp() AS now,r.version FROM claimed r JOIN biz_payment p ON p.id=r.payment_id AND NOT p.deleted
